question_text: Which of the following is a disadvantage of using cash to pay for your car insurance?
question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
choices: There are no fees associated with cash.
Some companies ask that you do not send cash by mail.
Cash cannot be destroyed.
solution:
x There are no fees associated with cash.
You do not need to pay your bank a fee to use cash. This is an advantage of paying with cash, not a disadvantage.

Some companies ask that you do not send cash by mail.
If you want to pay for your car insurance through the mail, it is unlikely you will be able to do so with cash. This is a disadvantage of paying with cash.

x Cash cannot be destroyed.
Cash can be destroyed, and then its value is gone. So, this statement is not true.

question_text: Which of the following is an advantage of using a cheque to buy a bicycle?
question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
choices: You will have a record of your purchase in case you need to return the bicycle.
If there is not enough money in your account, you must pay a fee.
You don't need a bank account to write a cheque.
solution: A cheque lets you pay using the money you already have in your bank account. It can take a few days for your bank to send the money. So, using a cheque is slower than other ways to pay.

You will have a record of your purchase in case you need to return the bicycle.
If you lose the receipt, you can use the cheque to show that you purchased the bicycle. This is an advantage of using a cheque.

x If there is not enough money in your account, you must pay a fee.
Fees are a disadvantage of using a cheque, not an advantage.

x You don't need a bank account to write a cheque.
To write a cheque, you need a chequing account with money deposited in it. So, this statement is not true.

question_text: Which of the following is a disadvantage of using a credit card to pay for clothing?
question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
choices: Credit cards are so easy to use that you must be careful not to spend more money than you planned.
Credit cards are easy to carry and use.
If your credit card is lost or destroyed, you automatically lose your money.
solution: Remember, a credit card is a payment card that lets you buy items now and pay for them later. The bank that issues your credit card may charge an annual fee. The bank will also charge interest and late fees if you don't pay your credit card bill on time.

Credit cards are so easy to use that you must be careful not to spend more money than you planned.
Credit cards are so easy to use that you might lose track of how much you spend. The ability to buy now and pay later may lead you to spend more than you can pay back when your credit card bill is due. This is a disadvantage of paying with a credit card.

x Credit cards are easy to carry and use.
Credit cards are small and light, and they are accepted at most businesses. This is an advantage, not a disadvantage, of paying with a credit card.

x If your credit card is lost or destroyed, you automatically lose your money.
If your credit card is lost or destroyed, you can call the bank to have it cancelled. You do not automatically lose your money. So, this statement is not true.

question_text:
Jayla has $400 and wants to deposit her money into a savings account for one year.
Full Moon Bank pays $3 interest each year for every $100 in a savings account.
White Star Bank pays $4 interest each year for every $100 in a savings account.
White Star Bank charges a $6 yearly fee on savings accounts.
Which bank has the better savings option for Jayla?
question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
choices: Full Moon Bank
White Star Bank
solution: Find which savings option gives Jayla more money after one year.
Find how much money Jayla will have with Full Moon Bank.
Full Moon Bank pays $3 interest for every hundred dollars in a savings account. Jayla has 4 hundred dollars.

Multiply $3 by 4.
$3 \times 4 = 12$
Full Moon Bank will pay Jayla $12 interest.

Add $12 interest to the $400 Jayla has to start.
$400+$12=$412
Jayla will have $412 after one year if she keeps her money at Full Moon Bank.
Find how much money Jayla will have with White Star Bank.
White Star Bank pays $4 interest for every hundred dollars in a savings account. Jayla has 4 hundred dollars.

Multiply $4 by 4.
$4 \times 4 = 16$
White Star Bank will pay Jayla $16 interest.

Add $16 interest to the $400 Jayla has to start.
$400+$16=$416

Now, subtract the $6 yearly fee that White Star Bank charges.
$416-$6=$410
Jayla will have $410 after one year if she keeps her money at White Star Bank.
Since $412 is more than $410, Full Moon Bank has the better savings option for Jayla.

question_text:
Alvin wants to buy a Wheels On Fire skateboard, but he needs $233. He thinks of two plans to save this money.
Plan A: Save $11 each week for 21 weeks. Put the money in a savings account that will pay a total of $1 in interest.
Plan B: Save $10 each week for 23 weeks. Put the money in a savings account that will pay a total of $3 in interest.
Which plan should Alvin follow to save enough money to buy the skateboard?
question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
choices: Plan A
Plan B
solution: Alvin needs $233 to buy the skateboard. Find which plan will save enough money.

Find how much money Alvin will save with Plan A.
Plan A is to save $11 each week for 21 weeks and earn $1 in interest.

First, multiply $11 by 21.
$\$11 \cdot 21 = \$231$

Then, add $1 interest.
$\$231 + \$1 = \$232$
Alvin will only save $232 with Plan A. That is not enough money to buy the skateboard.

Find how much money Alvin will save with Plan B. 
Plan B is to save $10 each week for 23 weeks and earn $3 in interest.

First, multiply $10 by 23.
$\$10 \cdot 23 = \$230$

Then, add $3 interest.
$\$230 + \$3 = \$233$
Alvin will save $233 with Plan B. That is enough money to buy the skateboard.
Alvin should follow Plan B.

Earning interest gives you more money. This is an advantage, not a disadvantage, of opening a savings account.

A disadvantage of keeping the money at home is that Oscar could lose it.
Oscar could lose track of the money he keeps at home. His money is less safe at home than at a bank. This is a disadvantage of keeping money at home.

question_text:
Cody has $20 in a savings account. The interest rate is 5% per year and is not compounded. How much will he have in total in 1 year?
Use the formula $i = prt$, where $i$ is the interest earned, $p$ is the principal (starting amount), $r$ is the interest rate expressed as a decimal, and $t$ is the time in years.
$___
solution:
Write the rate as a decimal.
$5\% = 0.05$

Calculate the interest earned. 
$i = prt$
$= 20 \cdot 0.05 \cdot 1$
$= 1$

Find the total amount by adding the interest to the principal.
$1 + 20 = 21$
The total amount will be $21.00
